verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for an API-driven service like Stripe Identity, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a single secret key used for API calls and access to results. It never documents restricted, scoped or least-privilege keys for agents. The MCP server mention is a separate capability and does not show credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
